name: Acolyte
description: You were raised in the service of a religious order, pantheon, or sacred tradition.

name: Artisan
description: You served an apprenticeship with a master crafter, learning a trade.

name: Charlatan
description: You have a talent for deceptions, and you used it to make your way in the world.

name: Criminal
description: You have a history of breaking the law and survive by your wits.

name: Entertainer
description: You thrive in front of an audience and know how to entrance them.

name: Farmer
description: You lived a life of hard work, tending the soil or raising livestock.

name: Guard
description: You served as a sentry, a jailer, or a member of a watch.

name: Guide
description: You helped others navigate the wilderness and survive its dangers.

name: Hermit
description: You lived in seclusion for a formative period of your life.

name: Merchant
description: You traded in goods and services, navigating markets and caravans.

name: Noble
description: You were born into a family of high social standing and privilege.

name: Sage
description: You spent years studying the lore of the multiverse.

name: Sailor
description: You spent your formative years on a ship, facing the sea.

name: Scribe
description: You earned a living by copying documents and recording information.

name: Soldier
description: You were trained in the arts of war and served in a military force.

name: Wayfarer
description: You grew up on the streets, surviving by your wits and luck.
